visualStyle.colorMood: moss lantern frontier palette with high-contrast readable accents

stylePack.name: Cozy Moss Lantern Frontier
stylePack.themeSummary: Cozy and Mushroom motifs translated into warm frontier materials.

materialRules.rule: terrain colors are softened by ownership state
primary color with warm light contact shadow
selected color with high contrast against terrain

silhouetteRules: buildings use one readable primary silhouette per canonical target
terrain textures must remain legible under ownership overlays
animationRules: reduced-motion mode may disable all ambient animation
selection feedback must not obscure cell labels

universePack.name: Cozy Mushroom Charter
universePack.pitch: Cozy settlers and Mushroom crews build a civic frontier with Clover keeping the work bounded and legible.
universePack.cloverRole: Clover remains the trusted Foreman and explains each bounded action in-world.

species.name: Cozy settlers
species.description: Readable frontier citizens who keep the settlement grounded in canonical Agent Town work.

species.name: Mushroom crews
species.description: Theme-flavored helpers who add presentation flavor without adding autonomous mechanics.

factions.name: Cozy Settlers
factions.line: They want cozy supplies and a steady route outward.

factions.name: Mushroom Crews
factions.line: They turn cozy timber and mushroom stone into practical town work.

cultures.name: Cozy craft habit
cultures.civicHabit: plan one route, explain the cost, then complete the bounded claim.

cultures.name: Mushroom route custom
cultures.civicHabit: keep maps legible and make every generated label traceable to a canonical key.

techs.name: Cozy Civic Lamps
techs.unlockIntent: makes public works and night scenes readable

firstLoop.title: Cozy first route
firstLoop.objective: Choose a nearby cell, plan the cozy route, and complete the first claim.
firstLoop.successReceipt: Cozy route complete. Cozy Hall now has a visible path into the wider territory.
firstLoop.recovery: If resources are short, pick another adjacent cell or keep the claim planned.
